diagnostics.message: resource.aws_lambda_function.main is created before resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.main (the log group's name references the function's function_name, inverting the operational order). When a Lambda function is created before its '/aws/lambda/<name>' log group exists, AWS auto-creates that log group with default settings on first use, which then causes the aws_cloudwatch_log_group resource to fail with a ResourceAlreadyExistsException/conflict, or to be created after the auto-created group so its retention/kms/log_class settings are never applied. The log group's name can be computed from var.lambda.prefix and var.lambda.name instead of aws_lambda_function.main.function_name, so the log group can be created first and the function should depend on it (e.g. depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.main]).
